about: The epistola of the formulary “Chair of Saint Peter the Apostle” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect strangers of the dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia, according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, for the sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience and the sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: grace to you, and may peace be multiplied. Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who in keeping with His great mercy has given us rebirth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, into an inheritance incorruptible and undefiled and unfading, preserved in heaven for you, who in the power of God are kept safe through faith for salvation, prepared to be revealed at the last time. In this you will exult, if for a short while now you must be made sorrowful in various trials, so that the testing of your faith, much more precious than gold, which is tested through fire, may be found to result in praise and glory and honor when Jesus Christ our Lord is revealed.
